compiled_state.description:
## Summary
This parentless bug tracks the MCP blue-green autodeploy defect where two routine, documented non-error backoffs (port-exhausted/retire-cap and low-memory abort) were incorrectly recorded through `record_mcp_backoff_failure`, emitting `AUTODEPLOY_ERROR {reason: deploy_failed}` and inflating the general `rebar/host:deploy_errors` alarm.

## Current origin/main state
The implementation fix described by this ticket has already landed on `origin/main` in commit `c63d3d9dd313ee3a3fc743b3b0519b5c0b9ddec5` (Gerrit Change-Id `I430f89fd67cfa6dfd49f59bc59a2744ea54ab9f9`, Gerrit change 2421, ticket `6ada-6015-8ac3-44f5`). This ticket remains open only because it is a duplicate/open tracking record for the same defect. Execution for this ticket is therefore: verify the landed behavior against the documented contract, attach the landed fix commit to this ticket so the close gate can trace it, record the `caused_by` relation to the introducing ticket `6964-40bb-46c9-48a7`, then close this bug as `plan_defect`. No additional code change is expected unless validation shows the landed fix is incomplete.

## Documented contract
`infra/scripts/observability.sh` documents that `AUTODEPLOY_MCP_RETIRE_CAP` and `AUTODEPLOY_MCP_MEM_ABORT` are each kept out of `AUTODEPLOY_ERROR` so routine retire-cap / memory-abort deferrals never inflate `deploy_errors`. Sustained cases are already covered by the dedicated `rebar-autodeploy-mcp-retire-cap` and `mcp_mem_abort` alarms.

## Root cause / defect origin
The violating behavior was introduced by the MCP blue-green autodeploy work in commit `2a0a4b19f2ab` / ticket `6964-40bb-46c9-48a7`, which shipped both the documented observability contract and the original code path that emitted `deploy_failed` for routine backoffs. That is an internally inconsistent plan, so the close classification is `plan_defect`.

## Landed fix to verify
`infra/scripts/autodeploy.sh` now factors backoff-timer bookkeeping into `schedule_mcp_backoff`, keeps `record_mcp_backoff_failure` for genuine MCP deploy failures, and uses `record_mcp_routine_backoff` for the two routine paths. The routine variant schedules the same throttle/backoff file but does not call `err deploy_failed`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] A routine port-exhausted / retire-cap backoff emits `AUTODEPLOY_MCP_RETIRE_CAP`, writes the MCP backoff throttle file, and emits no `AUTODEPLOY_ERROR` / `deploy_failed` marker.
- [x] A routine low-memory abort emits `AUTODEPLOY_MCP_MEM_ABORT`, writes the MCP backoff throttle file, and emits no `AUTODEPLOY_ERROR` / `deploy_failed` marker.
- [x] Genuine MCP deploy failures still emit `AUTODEPLOY_ERROR` with `reason=deploy_failed` and `component=mcp`, preserving the general deploy-failure alarm.
- [x] The focused autodeploy MCP blue-green regression tests pass on the landed code, and `make lint` remains green.

## Verification plan
- Run `python -m pytest tests/scripts/test_autodeploy_mcp_bluegreen.py -q` from a fresh worktree on current `origin/main`.
- Confirm defect-seeded mutation (switching the two routine sites back to `record_mcp_backoff_failure`) makes the routine retire-cap and mem-abort regression tests fail for the expected `AUTODEPLOY_ERROR/deploy_failed` emission.
- Run `make lint` with the worktree `.venv` first on `PATH`.
- Attach landed commit `c63d3d9dd313ee3a3fc743b3b0519b5c0b9ddec5`, link `caused_by` to `6964-40bb-46c9-48a7`, and close the ticket after verification.

file_impact.reason: Factor backoff-timer bookkeeping out of the deploy_failed emission in record_mcp_backoff_failure; add a record_mcp_routine_backoff variant (schedule timer + log, no err deploy_failed) and switch the two routine paths (low-mem abort ~L899, port-exhausted retire-cap ~L908) to it so they no longer inflate deploy_errors. Genuine-failure paths keep record_mcp_backoff_failure.
Regression tests asserting the routine retire-cap/mem-abort paths emit their own marker but NOT AUTODEPLOY_ERROR/deploy_failed, while genuine failures still emit deploy_failed.
